statement: In this synthetic experiment, variant B showed a conversion lift of 1.5 percentage points, or 15 percent relative to control.
question: Would this conversion change justify testing variant B with real users?
decision: Use the synthetic result to design a real randomized test before any rollout decision.
grain: one conversion outcome per synthetic user, assigned to one of two arms

protocol.test_that_would_settle_it: Run a preregistered randomized holdout with real observations and a retention guardrail.
protocol.cost_of_being_wrong: A rollout based on synthetic numbers could reduce real conversion or retention.

uncertainty.method: Rounded unpooled two-proportion normal interval using synthetic counts only.

not_established: All arm counts and outcomes are synthetic; no real treatment effect was measured.
Randomization quality, long-term retention and effectiveness of the reported hygiene were not independently verified.
The MDE uses the equal baseline variance approximation and does not adjust for multiple comparisons.
